name: Visual Canvas & Editor
description: Drag-and-drop visual editing surface for nodes, edges, and layout; the primary interaction model for graph construction across all archetypes.
why_it_matters: Primary UI surface; absence or poor implementation directly causes flight to chat.

name: Pan, Zoom & Semantic Viewport
description: Scroll/drag pan, wheel/pinch zoom, fit-to-view, semantic zoom (overview to detail), keyboard navigation of the viewport.
why_it_matters: Essential for navigating large graphs; poor pan/zoom creates navigation overhead and disorientation.

name: Infinite Canvas with Regions
description: Infinite scroll surface with semantic regions, region labels, and background shading to organize 50+ node graphs into digestible logical sections.
why_it_matters: Combats cognitive overload (Lutz et al. >50 nodes); structures surface-area bloat.

name: Multi-Selection & Bulk Editing
description: Select multiple nodes/edges by box/lasso/shift; bulk edit properties, move, delete, align, or transform.
why_it_matters: Editing efficiency; single-item-only workflows feel tedious and bloated.

name: Undo/Redo with History
description: Full undo/redo stack with optional visual timeline/thumbnail history and jump-to-state.
why_it_matters: Standard UX expectation; absence creates fear of destructive edits.

name: Minimap / Overview Panel
description: Miniature overview of the full graph; click-to-navigate and draggable viewport indicator for wayfinding.
why_it_matters: Improves wayfinding in large graphs; absence causes disorientation.

name: Subgraph Grouping & Collapse/Expand
description: Group nodes into named containers/subgraphs; collapse to a single abstraction node and recursively expand. Metro-map-style abstraction for large workflows.
why_it_matters: Reduces visual complexity; essential for >100-node graphs and progressive disclosure.

name: Node System & Types
description: Extensible heterogeneous node system (data-source, transform, decision, agent, output, group) with schema-aware input/output ports.
why_it_matters: Fundamental building block; node model defines the tool's expressiveness.

name: Node Creation & Palette
description: Create nodes via palette, context menu, keyboard, or templates; bulk creation, node-type selection, reusable saved components.
why_it_matters: Core node-building operation; obscurity here pushes users to chat-based definition.

name: Node Properties / Inspector Panel
description: Inspect and edit node config: type, label, styling, metadata, and embedded logic (SQL/transform/prompt). Discoverable configuration surface.
why_it_matters: Poor discoverability of node options is a top driver of surface-area-bloat complaints.

name: Data Source Nodes
description: Nodes representing SQL/NoSQL databases, APIs, webhooks, files, vector stores, knowledge bases; schema auto-detected, connection-pooled, cached.
why_it_matters: Entry points for the ICP's data; first-class source nodes are table stakes for a DB tool.

name: Transform & Processing Nodes
description: SQL/jq/Python/JS transforms plus prebuilt map/filter/reduce/join/aggregate/split nodes with visual schema inference on output ports.
why_it_matters: Core data manipulation; prebuilt transforms reduce reliance on custom code.

name: Decision & Branching Nodes
description: If-then-else, switch-case, error-handler, and fan-out/fan-in node primitives with a visual, schema-aware condition editor.
why_it_matters: Control-flow as visible nodes; n8n/Zapier/Airflow baseline.

name: LLM Agent Node
description: First-class agent node: LLM call with tool access, prompt template, and stateful memory across runs. Makes the agent a visible graph citizen.
why_it_matters: Resolves agent-vs-graph confusion by representing agents as nodes, not a hidden chat.

name: Output & Sink Nodes
description: Write to DB, call APIs, post webhooks, send notifications, export files; batch vs. streaming modes with audit trail.
why_it_matters: Closes the loop from read to action; required for any executable workflow.

name: Custom Code / Script Node
description: Write arbitrary JS/Python/SQL in a node with autocomplete and library imports; escape hatch for power users.
why_it_matters: Avoids surface-area bloat for edge cases; high adoption in n8n/Retool.

name: Live Data-Defined & JSON Components
description: MetroGraph differentiator: node output becomes a live data source for JSON-defined UI components (forms, tables, charts) that update in real time.
why_it_matters: Core wedge: data-defined live components bridge visualization and app-building; rare across the market.

name: Edges & Data-Flow Connections
description: Typed connections between nodes representing data flow or relationships; supports directed/undirected, one-to-many, many-to-one, branching.
why_it_matters: Edges are the graph's structure; their clarity governs comprehension.

name: Edge Creation / Connect Nodes
description: Draw edges via port click, drag-to-connect, or context menu; choose edge type/direction.
why_it_matters: Essential structural operation; friction here breaks the core build loop.

name: Edge Labeling & Styling
description: Edit edge label, weight, direction, color, and style; attach edge-specific metadata (key for knowledge graphs and ERD relationships).
why_it_matters: Semantic edges (cardinality, relationship type) are required for ERD/knowledge-graph fidelity.

name: Type-Aware Edge & Port Validation
description: Typed input/output ports with real-time validation that prevents invalid connections (e.g., string into a date port) and flags mismatches visually.
why_it_matters: Prevents silent runtime errors; key for workflow/agent-graph correctness.

name: Intelligent Edge Routing
description: Orthogonal/curved routing that minimizes crossings, auto-reroutes on node move, and bundles edges in dense graphs (metro-map style).
why_it_matters: Edge occlusion is a primary readability failure in large node graphs.

name: Edge Data Preview & Sampling
description: Hover an edge to see sample rows (e.g., first 5) and a row-count flowing through it. MetroGraph-leaning differentiator for debugging pipelines.
why_it_matters: Makes data flow visible in-canvas, reducing the need to drop to chat or external query tools.

name: Data Binding & Variable System
description: Runtime variable binding across the workflow (input to transform to output) with an expression language and schema-aware autocomplete for references.
why_it_matters: Core MetroGraph differentiator vs. abstract tools; binds nodes to live data for the SQL/NoSQL ICP.

name: Live Data Preview & Sample Data
description: Show real data from nodes as you build: streaming preview, row counts, type validation, freshness indicators, cached + incremental refresh.
why_it_matters: Core wedge: live data-defined components enable rapid iteration and cut AI-chat data questions.

name: Visual Expression & Variable Editor
description: Low-code expression language ({{ }}/jq/Excel-like) with syntax highlighting, schema-aware autocomplete, error indicators, and type casting/coercion UI.
why_it_matters: Parameterization and computed fields; n8n/Zapier/Airflow expectation, lowered for non-coders.

name: Recursive Inspect & JSON Drill-Down
description: MetroGraph differentiator: click any value or node to recursively inspect nested objects/arrays/subgraphs via a JSON tree with path-to-value, search, copy-path, and breadcrumbs.
why_it_matters: Unique wedge: drill into complex hierarchies without overwhelm; reduces cognitive load and chat queries.

name: RAG & Vector Retrieval Visualization
description: Visualize retrieved documents, relevance/similarity scores, chunking strategy, nearest neighbors, and embedding space (RAGViz-style diagnostics) over vector-DB connectors.
why_it_matters: RAG pipelines fail silently without retrieval visibility; vector-DB market is growing 23-27% CAGR.

name: Data Source Integration & Connections
description: Connection manager for SQL, NoSQL, graph DBs, REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, vector stores, and message queues, with pooling and lifecycle management.
why_it_matters: Connectivity breadth defines addressable integrations for the data-engineer/startup ICP.

name: Connection Manager & Secrets
description: Centralized connection registry with encrypted credential storage (OAuth, API keys, connection strings), test-before-save, and reuse across workflows.
why_it_matters: Secure, reusable connections are foundational; ad-hoc credentials are an enterprise blocker.

name: SQL / Relational Database Support
description: Native PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, DuckDB; schema auto-discovery, read/write separation, transaction modes, pooling.
why_it_matters: Core to the SQL-startup ICP; table stakes for any DB-visualization tool.

name: NoSQL / Document Store Support
description: Native MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, and other document/wide-column stores with schema inference over schemaless data.
why_it_matters: The ICP explicitly includes NoSQL startups; schema-on-read introspection is a differentiator.

name: Graph Database Support
description: Neo4j, TigerGraph, JanusGraph with Cypher/Gremlin querying, native traversal, and graph visualization of results.
why_it_matters: Anchors the graph-DB-viz archetype (Bloom/Linkurious competitor parity).

name: Vector Store & Embedding Support
description: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, ChromaDB connectors for similarity search and semantic retrieval in RAG pipelines.
why_it_matters: Required for the RAG/agent-builder archetype; fast-growing requirement.

name: API, Webhook & Queue Ingestion
description: REST/GraphQL/gRPC connectors plus inbound webhooks and message-queue consumers (Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS) with auth, pagination, rate-limit, retry handling.
why_it_matters: Event-driven and external-service ingestion; n8n/Zapier core.

name: Prebuilt Connector Library
description: Catalog of prebuilt connectors for 100s of SaaS apps (Salesforce, Slack, GitHub, HubSpot...) with OAuth/API-key flows.
why_it_matters: Breadth is a competitive moat (n8n 600+, Zapier 6000+); raises adoption surface.

name: Schema Introspection & Discovery
description: Auto-discover schema from any source (SQL tables, API endpoints, file headers, NoSQL samples); inspect tables, columns, types, relationships, cardinality.
why_it_matters: Lets data engineers navigate complex schemas in-tool; Azimutt/dbdiagram baseline.

name: Visual Schema Explorer & Column Browser
description: Tree/graph view of schema with column types, constraints, null ratio, and sample values; search/filter columns and jump to usage.
why_it_matters: Removes the need for external schema tools; core for data-engineer ICP.

name: ERD & Relationship Diagram Rendering
description: Render schema as an entity-relationship diagram: foreign keys, cardinality (1:1, 1:N, N:M), constraints, circular relationships, auto-laid-out from introspection.
why_it_matters: Anchors the ERD-modeling archetype (dbdiagram/Azimutt/Prisma); helps grasp schema topology.

name: Visual & Code Query Building
description: Dual-mode query construction: visual builder (drag columns, filter, join, aggregate) and code editor (SQL/Cypher/jq), with live execution and result preview.
why_it_matters: Spans BI (Metabase) and DB tooling; the bridge between non-coders and engineers.

name: Visual Query Builder
description: Drag-and-drop table/column selection, filtering, joins, grouping, ordering that generates SQL/Cypher; for non-technical users.
why_it_matters: Lowers the SQL barrier; core BI/low-code expectation.

name: Code-First Query Editor (SQL/Cypher/jq)
description: Full query editor with syntax highlighting, schema-aware autocomplete, error indicators, formatting, and visual-to-text conversion for SQL, Cypher, SPARQL, and jq.
why_it_matters: Engineers expect raw query power; Neo4j Browser / SQL-IDE parity.

name: Result Preview & Inspection
description: Live result preview (first N rows), pagination, column sorting, row expansion, and table/JSON/grid view modes with export.
why_it_matters: Immediate feedback closes the build loop; BI/notebook baseline.

name: Query Parameterization & Binding
description: Named parameters (${param}/@param) bound to workflow variables at runtime, with type checking and injection-safe binding; runtime input prompts/forms.
why_it_matters: Reusable parameterized queries/workflows; Retool/Appsmith baseline and a security need.

name: Graph Layout Engine
description: Multiple layout algorithms (metro-map, hierarchical, force-directed, circular) with live update and user-guided control; presets for common patterns.
why_it_matters: >50 nodes imposes significant cognitive load; layout quality is a readability lever.

name: Metro-Map / Schematic Orthogonal Layout
description: MetroGraph signature: subway-map style layout with orthogonal/octilinear edges, minimal crossings, regular angles, edge bundling, and semantic grouping; user-tunable constraints.
why_it_matters: Core differentiator and brand wedge; unique readability vs. Bloom/Cytoscape/Gephi.

name: Hierarchical / Layered Layout
description: Left-to-right or top-to-bottom flow layout optimized for workflows, minimizing edge crossings with progressive depth disclosure.
why_it_matters: Default mental model for pipelines/DAGs; Airflow/n8n expectation.

name: Force-Directed / Organic Layout
description: Physics-based layout with adjustable repulsive/attractive forces; good for exploring relationship structure in dense graphs.
why_it_matters: Standard graph-viz expectation (Gephi/Cytoscape) for exploratory analysis.

name: Manual Positioning & Snap-to-Grid
description: Free-form drag positioning with snap-to-grid, alignment guides, distribute-evenly, layout constraints, and remembered manual positions alongside auto-layout.
why_it_matters: User-guided refinement and semantic positioning complement auto-layout.

name: Performance at Scale (1000+ Nodes)
description: Render and interact with massive graphs via virtualization, incremental rendering, lazy loading, and incremental layout.
why_it_matters: Enterprise pipelines are large; Memgraph/BigGraphVis research shows this is a hard, decisive constraint.

name: Graph Navigation & Exploration
description: Search, filter, focus-mode, breadcrumb navigation, and connection tracing to keep users oriented in large graphs.
why_it_matters: Prevents getting lost; weak navigation pushes users back to text/chat.

name: Search & Filter Nodes/Edges
description: Full-text search across node/edge names, types, tags, properties, and data preview; filter by category/status/connectivity with fuzzy and regex matching and visual highlighting.
why_it_matters: Essential discovery/debugging in large graphs; absence drives chat queries.

name: Focus Mode & Subgraph Navigation
description: Click a node/subgraph to isolate it plus neighbors; breadcrumb navigation to step in/out without losing context.
why_it_matters: Reduces visual overwhelm; complements recursive-inspect for hierarchy work.

name: Data Lineage & Impact Tracing
description: Click an edge/node to highlight the data-flow path; trace upstream dependencies and downstream impact, find nodes using a given column/schema, and preview change propagation.
why_it_matters: Critical for governance, debugging, and impact analysis; Gartner DataOps flags lineage as a top pain.

name: Graph Analytics & Statistics
description: Topology metrics: node/edge counts, density, shortest path, centrality, community detection.
why_it_matters: Cytoscape/Gephi parity for analytical users; nice-to-have for most ICP workflows.

name: AI-Assisted Building (Copilot)
description: In-canvas AI that generates, configures, explains, and debugs graphs from natural language, keeping users in the visual tool instead of fleeing to external chat.
why_it_matters: AI+UI parity wedge: embed AI inside the canvas to counter flight-to-chat.

name: Natural Language to Graph/Workflow
description: Describe a workflow in English; the LLM generates an initial node/edge skeleton the user refines visually.
why_it_matters: Bootstraps complex workflows from a prompt; enables the agent-and-graph hybrid.

name: AI Node Suggestion & Pattern Detection
description: Context-aware next-node suggestions and property autocomplete from data/graph state; detects anti-patterns (missing error handler, inefficient join) and suggests fixes.
why_it_matters: Teaches best practices in-canvas without an explicit chat detour; reduces menu hunting.

name: AI Code Generation for Transforms
description: Describe a transformation in English; the LLM generates SQL/jq/Python plus test suggestions for the node.
why_it_matters: Lowers the coding barrier inside custom-code nodes; prevents hand-coding errors.

name: Context-Aware AI Chat Sidebar
description: Sidebar copilot aware of the current graph/data: answer questions, suggest and apply changes, explain nodes, and auto-document the workflow.
why_it_matters: Keeps users in-canvas; a context-aware copilot beats generic external chat and curbs flight-to-chat.

name: AI-Powered Debugging & Error Explanation
description: LLM analyzes failed runs, explains errors in plain language, and proposes concrete fixes or refactors that remove redundant nodes.
why_it_matters: Cuts debugging friction; addresses surface-area bloat by suggesting cleanup.

name: AI Data Exploration (NL Query)
description: Chat to explore datasets in natural language ('what columns are in table X', 'rows where Y>Z'); translates to queries against bound sources.
why_it_matters: Data democratization for non-SQL users; shrinks the learning curve.

name: AI + UI Parity (No Capability Cliff)
description: MetroGraph core principle: chat and visual UI express the same logic over one shared state — chat can build/edit workflows and every chat action is reflected and editable on the canvas. No reduced surface area in chat.
why_it_matters: The central wedge: resolves agent-vs-graph-chat confusion and the flight-to-chat HCI failure by making AI and UI first-class equals.

name: Agent & Workflow Orchestration
description: Execution engine plus multi-agent coordination: control flow, state, parallelism, and agentic loops with tool use — all as first-class, visible graph elements.
why_it_matters: Bridges LangGraph/LlamaIndex-style agents and workflow UIs; resolves agent-vs-graph confusion.

name: Graph Execution / Run Engine
description: Execute the graph as a workflow: run all or a subset of nodes, sequentially or in parallel, with manual or programmatic triggering.
why_it_matters: Core execution model; Airflow/n8n/Dagster baseline. MetroGraph must unify UI and execution.

name: Control Flow (Conditionals & Loops)
description: If-then-else, switch, for-each/while loops, map/reduce over arrays/streams, and a visual condition builder governing execution order.
why_it_matters: Essential control/batch patterns; n8n/Zapier/Airflow core.

name: Execution Context & State Management
description: Pass data between nodes, manage state across a run, and access global/run context and agent memory.
why_it_matters: Multi-step workflows and agents are impossible without coherent state; LangGraph/Airflow baseline.

name: Error Handling & Retry Logic
description: Error handlers, retry policies (exponential backoff), fallback nodes/agents, conditional branching on error, and loop-guard limits.
why_it_matters: Production pipelines require resilience; Airflow/Dagster expectation; prevents runaway agent loops.

name: Parallelization, Dependency & Caching
description: Auto-detect and respect node dependencies, parallelize independent paths (with visual indication), memoize node outputs, and skip re-execution of unchanged nodes.
why_it_matters: Performance and correctness of execution order; Airflow/Dagster core; caching speeds large-data iteration.

name: Batch & Streaming Execution Modes
description: Process bounded batches or unbounded streams with incremental processing and windowing.
why_it_matters: Data-engineering staple; Airflow/Dagster/Prefect/Flink patterns.

name: Agentic Loop Visualization
description: Visualize the think-act-observe agent loop with step-by-step trace, reasoning/action/observation steps, and token counts.
why_it_matters: Answers 'what is the agent doing'; the transparency that distinguishes a graph from a black-box chat.

name: Tool-Use & Function Calling
description: Visual tool registry (DB queries, APIs, external services); agent selects tools from a palette with input/output schema mapping and an execution trace of calls.
why_it_matters: Makes agent capabilities explicit and governable; core to the agent-builder archetype.

name: Prompt Template & Few-Shot Editor
description: Visual prompt builder with variable binding from workflow state, few-shot example editor, system-role customization, and a token counter.
why_it_matters: Prompts are the agent's logic; Flowise/Langflow/Dify baseline.

name: Agent State & Decision-Tree Visualization
description: Visualize the agent's decision tree — which tools it chose, why, and the reasoning — mapped onto the graph structure.
why_it_matters: Directly resolves agent-vs-graph confusion by mapping agentic decisions onto the visible graph.

name: Collaboration
description: Multi-user editing, presence, and commenting so teams build graphs together.
why_it_matters: Figma/Miro set the baseline; Retool/Appsmith are moving toward live collaboration.

name: Real-Time Collaboration & Presence
description: CRDT-based (Yjs/Automerge) conflict-free concurrent editing with live cursors, presence/avatars, and offline-first sync on reconnect.
why_it_matters: Emerging expectation for collaborative canvases; reduces merge friction.

name: Comments & Annotations
description: Threaded comments on nodes/edges/regions with @mentions, resolved/unresolved state, and persistent history.
why_it_matters: Lightweight documentation and review without leaving the canvas.

name: Versioning & History
description: Git-style version control for graphs: snapshots, commit history, branching/merging, diffs, and revert.
why_it_matters: Team change-tracking and governance; dbt/Airflow users expect version control parity.

name: Version History & Snapshots
description: Auto-save snapshots and a commit timeline with timestamps/authors; quick-jump and revert to any prior version.
why_it_matters: Change tracking and safe iteration; a governance requirement (Gartner LCAP).

name: Git Integration & Branch/Merge
description: Commit graphs to Git with branch workflows, merge-conflict resolution, and protected-main review gates.
why_it_matters: Engineering teams expect Git parity (dbt/Airflow); enables experimentation branches.

name: Visual Diff & Change Comparison
description: Side-by-side comparison of two versions highlighting added/removed/modified nodes, edges, and properties.
why_it_matters: Makes graph changes legible over time; a hard problem competitors handle poorly.

name: Deploy & Execution Management
description: Publish workflows to production, schedule recurring runs, trigger via webhook/event, and manage hosting.
why_it_matters: A built graph must run reliably in production; orchestration archetype core.

name: Publish, Version-Lock & Rollback
description: Promote a workflow version to a production environment with an immutable lock; roll back to a previous version and undo executed effects where supported.
why_it_matters: Prevents accidental prod changes and enables recovery; production-safety baseline.

name: Scheduling (Cron & Timezones)
description: Cron-based scheduling with a visual cron editor, timezone support, run history, and next-run display.
why_it_matters: Automation staple for data pipelines; Airflow/Dagster/Prefect core.

name: Webhook & Event-Driven Execution
description: Expose the graph as an HTTP endpoint and trigger on webhook/event with payload validation, replay, and a response.
why_it_matters: Event-driven workflows; n8n/Zapier/Retool standard.

name: Cloud & Self-Hosted Deployment
description: Deploy to AWS/GCP/Azure/Kubernetes (serverless/containerized, auto-scaling) and self-hosted/on-prem/air-gapped options.
why_it_matters: Cloud is table stakes for SaaS; self-hosting unlocks regulated/data-residency buyers.

name: Observability & Monitoring
description: Execution logs, metrics dashboards, alerting, and cost tracking for running workflows and agents.
why_it_matters: Visibility into runs is decisive; lack of it is a documented driver of flight-to-chat.

name: Execution Logs & Step Debugging
description: Per-node execution logs with inputs/outputs, step-through debugging, intermediate result inspection, data sampling at each step, and inline error/status surfacing on the canvas.
why_it_matters: Top debugging pain (Gartner DataOps); poor run-visibility is a primary cause of users abandoning the canvas for chat.

name: Metrics, Profiling & Resource Monitoring
description: Dashboard of run count, success/error rate, and durations; per-node profiling to find bottlenecks and parallelization opportunities; CPU/memory/IO resource tracking with anomaly detection.
why_it_matters: Performance and reliability insight for data engineers; Gartner DataOps flags performance as a pain.

name: Alerting & Notifications
description: Alerts on failure, data anomaly, or SLA breach via Slack/email/PagerDuty, with alert rules and escalation policies.
why_it_matters: Production pipelines need failure notification; Airflow/Prefect core.

name: LLM Token & Cost Tracking
description: Track tokens and cost per node/run, aggregate usage over time, and surface cost per workflow.
why_it_matters: Cost management for AI-heavy workflows; Flowise/Retool users care.

name: Auth, RBAC & Governance
description: Authentication (SSO), role-based access control, audit logging, and data-protection policies for enterprise trust.
why_it_matters: Governance is the 2025 LCAP differentiator (Gartner); a hard enterprise gate.

name: Role-Based Access Control & Workspaces
description: Viewer/editor/admin roles with workspace-, graph-, and node-level permissions; team-based sharing and multi-tenant workspace separation.
why_it_matters: Enterprise requirement; scopes access as teams scale.

name: SSO / OAuth / SAML Authentication
description: Google/GitHub/Okta/AzureAD/OIDC and generic SAML, LDAP/AD integration, and MFA.
why_it_matters: Table stakes for enterprise SaaS procurement.

name: Comprehensive Audit Logging
description: Log all changes, executions, and data access (who/what/when); query with filters and export compliance reports (SOC2/HIPAA).
why_it_matters: Compliance and debugging; Gartner DataOps flags observability/audit as key.

name: Data Protection (Encryption, Masking, RLS)
description: TLS in transit and encryption at rest (optional E2E), PII masking in results, and row-/column-level security policies per role.
why_it_matters: Handling production data demands protection; regulatory baseline for the startup ICP.

name: Extensibility & Plugin System
description: SDKs and public APIs to add custom nodes and embed/automate MetroGraph in other systems.
why_it_matters: Ecosystem leverage; lets verticals extend the tool without core bloat.

name: Custom Node SDK & Plugins
description: SDK (JS/TS) to build, package, and share custom nodes/plugins; community marketplace for distribution.
why_it_matters: Enables an ecosystem and vertical extensions; n8n/Zapier model.

name: Public API & Embed SDK
description: REST API to manage workflows programmatically and an SDK to embed MetroGraph in other apps, with webhook callbacks for external events.
why_it_matters: Programmatic control and embedding broaden distribution and platform plays.

name: Onboarding & Learning
description: Templates, interactive tutorials, and in-context help that get new users to first success while managing surface-area bloat via progressive disclosure.
why_it_matters: Time-to-first-success drives activation; progressive disclosure counters bloat.

name: Workflow & Pattern Template Gallery
description: Searchable gallery of prebuilt workflows and reusable subgraph patterns (ETL, webhook-to-DB, RAG chatbot, data-quality check) with one-click instantiation.
why_it_matters: Accelerates time-to-value; n8n/Airflow show templates are highly valued.

name: Interactive Tutorials & Quickstart
description: In-app guided tours, blank-canvas quickstart, sample databases/graphs, and video walkthroughs with a sandbox.
why_it_matters: Reduces onboarding friction for a feature-dense tool.

name: In-Context Help & Node Documentation
description: Hover tooltips, contextual help panels, searchable help, and built-in per-node-type docs (parameters, examples, output format).
why_it_matters: Addresses surface-area-bloat discovery so users find options without chat.

name: Import / Export & Interop
description: Exchange graphs, workflows, and data across standard formats and competing tools.
why_it_matters: Interop lowers switching cost and supports the ICP's existing Airflow/dbt stack.

name: Graph & Data Format Import/Export
description: Load/save graphs as JSON/GraphML/DOT, export visuals as PNG/SVG, and import/export tabular data as CSV/JSON/Parquet/SQL/Avro with streaming for large sets.
why_it_matters: Standard-format interchange is expected; sharing/portability is table stakes.

name: Workflow Compatibility & Code Export
description: Import workflows from n8n/Zapier/Airflow/dbt (with node mapping) and export to Airflow DAGs, n8n JSON, Python, or SQL plus auto-generated README/docs.
why_it_matters: Bridges visual and code worlds; the ICP often wants to export to Airflow/dbt and migrate off competitors.

name: UX Chrome & Accessibility
description: Cross-cutting interface affordances: theming, keyboard control, accessibility, and responsiveness.
why_it_matters: Polish and inclusivity reduce friction and broaden the addressable user base.

name: Themes, Dark Mode & Styling
description: Light/dark/high-contrast modes, color themes, custom node shapes, and data-flow-based conditional coloring for comprehension and branding.
why_it_matters: Aesthetic fit plus semantic color-coding that HCI research shows aids large-graph reading.

name: Keyboard Shortcuts & Command Palette
description: Comprehensive shortcuts and a Cmd/Ctrl-K command palette for discoverable, fast actions; custom keybindings.
why_it_matters: Power-user efficiency and action discoverability; counters menu/surface-area bloat.

name: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
description: Keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, sufficient color contrast, and ARIA labeling across the canvas and panels.
why_it_matters: Legal/ethical requirement and an enterprise procurement check; widens the user base.
